# Studio Click House (SCHL)

> Studio Click House Limited (SCHL) is a full-service creative post-production studio based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with offices in Stockholm, Sydney, and London. The studio provides high-end image editing, photo retouching, video color grading, and photorealistic 3D CGI product rendering for global e-commerce brands, retailers, agencies, and photo studios.
